name: Corning

eyebrow.en: Corning Incorporated · Common stock · Corning, New York
eyebrow.zh: 康宁公司 · 普通股 · 纽约州康宁

title.en: A 175-year-old glassmaker, rewired for AI data centers.
title.zh: 一家 175 年历史的玻璃制造商，为 AI 数据中心重新布线。

lede.en: Corning makes specialty glass, ceramics and optical fiber. AI data centers are now the engine: Optical Communications sales rose 44% to $2.38B last quarter, and core sales already hit a $20.3B annual run rate, beating the end-2026 Springboard target a quarter early; the plan aims for $40B by 2030. The catch is the cost, with $1.3B of capex in nine months and a $2B share-sale program, and a stock that went from $255 to $124 and sits near $126 after the Q3 beat.
lede.zh: 康宁生产特种玻璃、陶瓷和光纤。AI 数据中心已成为增长引擎：上季光通信销售增长 44% 至 23.8 亿美元，核心销售年化已达 203 亿美元，提前一季超过 Springboard 计划 2026 年底的目标；计划 2030 年达 400 亿美元。代价是扩张成本：前九个月资本开支 13 亿美元，另有 20 亿美元增发计划；股价由 $255 跌至 $124，Q3 超预期后仍在 $126 附近。

s.zh: 核心每股收益一致预期 $4.42 · GAAP 滚动约 51 倍

sub_price.en: Daily closes with the 50-day average. Corning nearly tripled from about $86 a year ago to a $255 close on Jun 29, then fell to $124 on Jul 29 after its Q2 report. After trading mostly between $143 and $170 from August to mid-October, it slid to $124 on Oct 22 and closed at $126 on Oct 27 after its Q3 beat.
sub_price.zh: 每日收盘价与50日均线。康宁由一年前约 $86 涨近两倍至 6月29日收盘 $255，Q2 财报后于 7月29日跌至 $124。8月至10月中旬大致在 $143 至 $170 之间波动，10月22日跌至 $124，10月27日 Q3 超预期后收于 $126。

sub_rev.en: Revenue in US$ millions (GAAP net sales), with GAAP gross margin on the right axis. Corning's fiscal year is the calendar year. Corning guides on "core" sales, which use fixed or hedged currency rates and have run about $180–230M above GAAP sales in recent quarters ($226M in Q3 2026). The last bar is my GAAP estimate for Q4 2026: the $5.2–5.3B core guide minus that gap.
sub_rev.zh: 营收单位为百万美元（GAAP 净销售额），右轴为 GAAP 毛利率。康宁财年即日历年。公司以“核心”销售给出指引，核心销售采用固定或对冲汇率，近几季比 GAAP 销售高约 1.8–2.3 亿美元（2026 年第三季为 2.26 亿）。最后一根柱为我对 2026 年第四季 GAAP 销售的估算：52–53 亿美元核心指引减去该差额。

p.en: Enterprise Networks sales rose 84% and generative AI product sales more than doubled. Corning has multiyear supply deals with Meta (up to $6B), Amazon, NVIDIA and AT&T (over $3B), and management says new long-term deals share the cost and risk of added capacity.
p.zh: 企业网络销售增长 84%，生成式 AI 产品销售增长逾一倍。康宁已与 Meta（最高 60 亿美元）、亚马逊、英伟达及 AT&T（逾 30 亿美元）签订多年供货协议，管理层表示新的长期协议由客户分担扩产成本与风险。

p.en: Core operating margin rose 310 bp to 22.7% and core ROIC 330 bp to 16.7%. Optical net income grew 80%, faster than its 44% sales growth, and the Q4 guide calls for core EPS up about 36% again.
p.zh: 核心营业利润率提升 310 基点至 22.7%，核心投资回报率提升 330 基点至 16.7%。光通信净利增长 80%，快于 44% 的销售增速；Q4 指引核心每股收益再增约 36%。

p.en: Solar grew 37% to $436M but still lost $7M; the ramp is running slower than planned and the CFO says it drags on group margin for now. New US Section 232 trade action should help pricing on the way to a $3B-plus revenue stream.
p.zh: 太阳能业务增长 37% 至 4.36 亿美元，但仍亏损 700 万；爬坡慢于计划，CFO 表示目前拖累集团利润率。美国新的 232 条款贸易措施应有助定价，目标收入逾 30 亿美元。

p.en: Capex was $545M in Q3 and $1.30B in nine months, on track for about $2B this year. Adjusted free cash flow still reached $2.27B year to date, helped by customer prepayments, and a $2B at-the-market share program is in place.
p.zh: Q3 资本开支 5.45 亿美元，前九个月 13.0 亿，全年约 20 亿。在客户预付款帮助下，年初至今调整后自由现金流仍达 22.7 亿美元，另设有 20 亿美元的市价增发计划。

p.en: At about 29 times 2027 core EPS consensus, beats are not enough: the stock slipped 1% on a beat-and-raise quarter, after a 12% drop on the July guide. Truist cut its target to $175 on valuation while raising estimates.
p.zh: 按 2027 年核心每股收益一致预期计约 29 倍，单纯超预期已不够：本季业绩与指引双双超预期，股价仍跌 1%；7月指引曾令股价单日下跌 12%。Truist 上调盈利预测，但因估值将目标价下调至 175 美元。

p.en: The top two Optical customers were 28% of segment sales in 2025. Glass Innovations sales fell 3% to $1.51B as handheld demand weakens on memory prices, and Life Sciences and emerging businesses lost $28M on $290M of sales.
p.zh: 2025 年光通信前两大客户占该部门销售 28%。受内存涨价导致手持设备需求走弱影响，玻璃创新销售下降 3% 至 15.1 亿美元；生命科学及新兴业务销售 2.9 亿美元，亏损 2800 万。

p.en: $0.28 a share, paid Dec 11. The dividend has been flat since 2023.
p.zh: 每股 $0.28，12月11日派发。股息自 2023 年以来未变。

p.en: Guide is $5.2–5.3B core sales and $0.96–1.00 core EPS, a run rate near $21B. Expect the 2027 capex plan; last year's report came on Feb 3.
p.zh: 指引为核心销售 52–53 亿美元、核心每股 $0.96–1.00，年化约 210 亿美元。届时预计公布 2027 年资本开支计划；去年财报于 2月3日发布。

sources: Q3 beat vs. estimates and segments (Zacks via Yahoo Finance)
Q3 slides: stock falls on capex concerns (Investing.com)
Price, market cap and range: Stocklake; EPS consensus: WallStreetZen, as of Oct 28, 2026

foot.en: Fundamentals as of Oct 28, 2026 (Q3 2026 results). For information only, not investment advice. Not affiliated with Corning Incorporated.
foot.zh: 基本面数据截至 2026年10月28日（2026 年第三季业绩）。仅供参考，不构成投资建议。与 Corning Incorporated 无关联。

guide: Dec 2026 · $5.25B core guide midpoint less ~$230M core-to-GAAP gap (my estimate)
2026年12月 · 核心指引中值 52.5 亿减约 2.3 亿核心与 GAAP 差额（本人估算）

sub.en: Free cash flow is operating cash flow minus capital spending, in US$ millions, for the 20 quarters from Q4 2021 to Q3 2026. Corning's fiscal year is the calendar year. Q2 2026 operating cash flow includes a $1.0B upfront customer prepayment. Shaded bars and italic rows are estimates.
sub.zh: 自由现金流 = 经营现金流 − 资本开支，单位百万美元，涵盖 2021 年第四季至 2026 年第三季共 20 个季度。康宁财年即日历年。2026 年第二季经营现金流含 10 亿美元客户预付款。浅色柱与斜体行为估算。

read.en: Corning's free cash flow is seasonal: the March quarter is the weakest (negative in 2023, 2024 and 2025) and the second half is stronger. Q3 2026 brought $516M (operating cash flow $1.06B less $545M of capex; Corning's adjusted figure is $661M). Q2's record $1.30B included a $1.0B customer prepayment, so the last four quarters add up to about $2.5B, or about $1.5B without it.
read.zh: 康宁自由现金流有季节性：3月季度最弱（2023、2024、2025 年均为负），下半年较强。2026 年第三季为 5.16 亿美元（经营现金流 10.6 亿减资本开支 5.45 亿；公司口径调整后为 6.61 亿）。第二季创纪录的 13.0 亿含 10 亿客户预付款，因此近四季合计约 25 亿美元，剔除后约 15 亿。

read.en: My base case has capex of about $700M in Q4, completing the ~$2B 2026 plan, then $500–600M a quarter in 2027, with operating cash flow growing with core sales above $5B a quarter. That gives about $1.55B over four quarters. The main risk is that AI fiber orders slow after Corning has built capacity: spending and depreciation would stay high while volumes fell.
read.zh: 我的基准情景假设 Q4 资本开支约 7 亿美元，完成 2026 年约 20 亿的计划，2027 年每季 5–6 亿，经营现金流随每季逾 50 亿美元的核心销售增长，四季合计约 15.5 亿美元。主要风险是康宁扩产后 AI 光纤订单放缓：开支与折旧维持高位而销量下滑。

p.en: About $2B in 2026, mostly for Optical; $1.30B was spent in the first nine months.
p.zh: 2026 年约 20 亿美元，主要投向光通信；前九个月已支出 13.0 亿。

p.en: About $260M a quarter at $0.28 per share.
p.zh: 每股 $0.28，每季约 2.6 亿美元。

p.en: About $8.2B of debt against $2.5B of cash; about $0.9B is due within a year.
p.zh: 债务约 82 亿美元，现金 25 亿；约 9 亿一年内到期。

p.en: Customer deposits added $639M of cash in the first nine months, mainly the $1.0B Q2 prepayment under a deal running to 2029.
p.zh: 前九个月客户订金带来 6.39 亿美元现金，主要来自 Q2 一项期至 2029 年协议的 10 亿美元预付款。

p.en: Core sales are guided up 19% in Q4, with Optical margins rising.
p.zh: Q4 核心销售指引增长 19%，光通信利润率上升。

p.en: A $2B at-the-market share program and $500M of NVIDIA warrants can fund the build-out.
p.zh: 20 亿美元市价增发计划与 5 亿美元英伟达认股权证可为扩产提供资金。

bridgeNote.en: Leaves out any share sales under the $2B program and the ~$0.9B of debt due within a year, which could be repaid or refinanced. No shares were bought back in Q3.
bridgeNote.zh: 未计入 20 亿美元增发计划下的任何售股，也未计入约 9 亿一年内到期、可能偿还或再融资的债务。Q3 未回购股票。
